name: Internet Archive APIs (Search, Metadata, Wayback)
summary: Search and metadata for 40M+ books, audio, video, web captures and software, plus Wayback Machine lookup.
description: AdvancedSearch queries items with Lucene syntax and returns chosen fields; /metadata/{identifier} gives full item metadata and file lists; the Wayback availability API and CDX server find archived snapshots of URLs. Includes public-domain texts, 78rpm records, live music, software and web history.

auth.notes: S3-like keys are only needed for uploads.

rate_limit.summary: Not formally numbered; use reasonably. Heavy CDX queries may be throttled (HTTP 429). A User-Agent is recommended.

endpoints.summary: Closest Wayback snapshot of a URL

license.name: Varies per item (many public domain or Creative Commons); service terms apply

agent_notes: Use advancedsearch to find an identifier, then /metadata/{identifier} for files and license fields. The Wayback availability endpoint returns the closest snapshot to a timestamp (YYYYMMDDhhmmss). Always check the per-item license in the metadata.
caveats: Licensing is per item and must be read from item metadata.
The Wayback availability endpoint was also verified (closest snapshot, status 200).

hn.title: An update on Wayback Machine access
